title: Legal Standards / Terms & Conditions
slide_intent: Distinguish preliminary brand development from local readiness so teams understand that a global design system still needs market-specific clearance.
strategic_value: The prominent local-clearance instruction can help Burger King coordinate rollout across countries with different requirements.
demonstration: A small section label at left faces a large bold paragraph explaining preliminary searches and required local legal review before new brand elements are used.
practical_value: Identify local clearance as a stated prerequisite in this historical guide, rather than treating inclusion in the book as permission to launch.

content_islands.name: Section label
content_islands.spec: Place the compact Legal Standards / Terms & Conditions label at left.

content_islands.name: Clearance statement
content_islands.spec: Set the long, bold local-review paragraph across the upper central and right area, leaving open space below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph connects local review to the usability of brand content in each country.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The guide requires local legal representatives to clear icons and validate claims before a market uses new elements, allowing sufficient time for country-specific review.
